notes: Uses sum-of-squares freestream deficit superposition (sosfs), the TurbineCubatureGrid, 9 points rotor grid with power linear-cubature, thrust linear-cubature averaging, and Crespo-Hernandez wake-added turbulence. Secondary steering, yaw-added recovery, transverse velocities, and active wake mixing are disabled.
Converts the windIO coefficient with kd = beta / 2 because FLORIS uses 1 + 2*kd*x/D where the other implementations use 1 + beta*x/D.

Uses Betz induction, quadratic wind-speed superposition with a freestream (ws_quadratic_amb_target) deficit reference, grid16, 4 x 4 cell centers rotor sampling, rotor-point partial wakes, and the rotor_wd wake frame. No separate wake-added turbulence model is configured.
FOXES keeps its grid16 rotor model; the requested cubature with 9 points rotor grid is not applied.
Uses JimenezDeflection with rotate=False, translating the wake path without rotating the wake cross-section.

Uses PropagateDownwind with squared-sum superposition, CGIRotorAvg, 9 points rotor averaging, freestream (use_effective_ws=false) deficit reference, and ct2a_mom1d induction. No separate wake-added turbulence model is configured.
Uses the lower-level NOJDeficit class rather than PyWake's Jensen_1983 literature preset.

This is a coupled comparison: yaw-dependent thrust, velocity deficit, deflection, rotor averaging, and wake superposition can all contribute to differences. It does not isolate the deflection equation.
